print('exp负无穷极限:',sp.limit(sp.exp(x),x,-sp.oo))

notebooks.title: 功率分配与边界
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import minimize

cells.code:
def solve(r,b,weights=None):
    r=np.array(r,dtype=float); w=np.ones(2) if weights is None else np.array(weights,dtype=float)
    result=minimize(lambda u:np.dot(w,(u-r)**2)/2,[0.,0.],jac=lambda u:w*(u-r),bounds=[(0,None)]*2,constraints=[{'type':'ineq','fun':lambda u:b-np.sum(u),'jac':lambda u:-np.ones(2)}],method='SLSQP',options={'ftol':1e-12,'maxiter':100})
    assert result.success,result.message
    return result.x,result.fun
for r,b in [([2,1],2),([3,0],1),([2,1],0),([2,1],4)]:
    print('请求/上限/最优/目标:',r,b,solve(r,b))
print('主例梯度:',np.array([1.5,.5])-np.array([2.,1.]))
print('Hessian特征值:',np.linalg.eigvalsh(np.eye(2)))

notebooks.title: 对偶与KKT证书
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import minimize

cells.code:
r=sp.Matrix([2,1]); u=sp.Matrix([sp.Rational(3,2),sp.Rational(1,2)])
lam=sp.Rational(1,2); mu=sp.zeros(2,1); v=lam*sp.ones(2,1)-mu
primal=((u-r).dot(u-r))/2; dual=v.dot(r)-lam*2-v.dot(v)/2
print('目标/对偶/间隙:',primal,dual,primal-dual)
print('驻点残差:',u-r+v,'互补:',lam*(sum(u)-2))
print('非负乘子互补:',[mu[i]*(-u[i]) for i in range(2)])
print('lambda0下界:',0,'Slater点及余量:',[sp.Rational(1,2)]*2,1)
u0=sp.zeros(2,1); l0=sp.Integer(2); m0=sp.Matrix([0,1]); v0=l0*sp.ones(2,1)-m0
print('b0驻点/对偶:',u0-r+v0,v0.dot(r)-v0.dot(v0)/2)
x,l=sp.symbols('x l',real=True)
print('退化约束零点驻点:',(1+2*l*x).subs(x,0))
print('退化对偶lambda1/2:',-sp.Rational(1,4),-sp.Rational(1,8))
print('退化对偶极限:',sp.limit(-1/(4*l),l,sp.oo))

notebooks.title: 带权二次规划
notebooks.setupCode:
import numpy as np
import sympy as sp
from scipy.optimize import minimize

cells.code:
r=np.array([2.,1.]); w=np.array([2.,1.])
s=minimize(lambda u:np.dot(w,(u-r)**2)/2,[.5,.5],jac=lambda u:w*(u-r),bounds=[(0,None)]*2,constraints=[{'type':'ineq','fun':lambda u:2-np.sum(u),'jac':lambda u:-np.ones(2)}],method='SLSQP',options={'ftol':1e-12})
assert s.success
u=sp.Matrix([sp.Rational(5,3),sp.Rational(1,3)]); R=sp.Matrix([2,1]); H=sp.diag(2,1); l=sp.Rational(2,3)
print('数值解/目标:',s.x,s.fun)
print('精确解/乘子/目标:',u,l,((u-R).T*H*(u-R))[0]/2)
print('驻点:',H*(u-R)+l*sp.ones(2,1))
print('主例QP常数:',sp.Rational(1,2)*(2**2+1**2))
